title: There is a warrant—pay by kiosk
scenario: A caller claiming to be law enforcement says you missed a court notice and a warrant can be paused if you pay a bond today. They instruct you to stay on the line while withdrawing cash.

answers.A: Follow the instructions until you reach the payment step, then verify before sending anything.
answers.B: End the call and contact the court or police agency through official published numbers; do not pay on the caller’s instructions.
answers.C: Write down the officer name, badge number and case number, then verify them independently.

explanation: Threats and official-sounding details are designed to keep you compliant and isolated. Real agencies can be contacted independently.
